windows-safe8g-serial-v1.selection: All HELMS, standalone 2D-LS and LS-WL; RandInst/SpecInst V1,V2,V3,V4,V5

independent-OpenCAD-v1.timing_basis: OpenCAD plus returned-cell witness extraction; startup and verification separate
independent-OpenCAD-v1.input_policy: original exact CNF and manifest variable order; no LS/MCSAT preprocessing; no reference answer in request
independent-OpenCAD-v1.adaptation: Controller import and package-root/source/worker paths only; exact inverse substitution restores measured bytes. Worker and process-control bytes unchanged.

controller_adaptations: Package/import paths and code inventories are adapted to the public layout. Optional plotting and unused source-import workflows are omitted. Resource supervision, timeout handling and answer validation retain the measured implementations.

reference_version_limitations.LiMbS/SMTLIB: The retained CSV does not identify its exact library version. Measurements of the supplied upstream library are not an established version match.
reference_version_limitations.LiMbS/RandInst,SpecInst: The evidence identifies a modified library. The supplied upstream library is a different implementation; the observations are retained without relabeling their version.

HELMS_update: Measurements of the supplied self-contained HELMS implementation are indexed by benchmark and measurement ID in data/measurements.json, alongside retained-hybrid observations with their recorded execution profiles.
LS-WL_update: The supplied LS-WL defaults are in config/lswl_config.json. The measurement catalog includes 8-round benchmark observations and 64-round additional-input observations under their respective recorded execution profiles.

default_campaign.selection: 2D-LS and LS-WL: known SAT plus unlabelled; other methods: all inputs
